services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: rame-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: rame_studio
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/init-db:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d rame_studio"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: rame-api
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: Host=postgres;Port=5432;Database=rame_studio;Username=postgres;Password=postgres
      ASPNETCORE_URLS: http://+:5000
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Production
      Jwt__Secret: SuperSecretKeyForRameStudio2026JwtAuthMin32Chars!
      Jwt__Issuer: RameStudio
      Jwt__Audience: RameStudioApp
      Jwt__ExpiryMinutes: "60"
    ports:
      - "5002:5000"
    volumes:
      - uploads_data:/app/uploads

RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# Stage 2: Serve with nginx
FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
